trades.name: Trades & Construction
trades.description: For plumbers, electricians, builders, roofers, HVAC engineers, and general contractors. Manages job-based workflows, material quotes, compliance certificates, and trade-specific lead sources.

faq_knowledge.Question: Do you offer emergency call-outs?
faq_knowledge.Answer: Yes, we offer 24/7 emergency call-outs for urgent issues. Our emergency line is always available. Call-out fees apply depending on time and distance.

faq_knowledge.Question: Are you Gas Safe registered?
faq_knowledge.Answer: Yes, all our gas engineers are Gas Safe registered. We can provide our registration number on request, and our engineers carry their Gas Safe ID cards at all times.

faq_knowledge.Question: Do you provide written quotes?
faq_knowledge.Answer: Absolutely. We provide free, no-obligation written quotes for all jobs. Large projects may require a site visit before quoting.

faq_knowledge.Question: What areas do you cover?
faq_knowledge.Answer: We cover a 25-mile radius from our base. For larger projects, we may travel further - please contact us to discuss.

faq_knowledge.Question: Do you offer a guarantee on your work?
faq_knowledge.Answer: All our workmanship comes with a 12-month guarantee. Materials are covered by the manufacturer's warranty, typically 2-10 years depending on the product.

faq_knowledge.Question: Can you work evenings or weekends?
faq_knowledge.Answer: Yes, we offer flexible scheduling including evenings and Saturdays at no extra cost. Sunday work incurs a small surcharge.

faq_knowledge.Question: Do you charge for travel time?
faq_knowledge.Answer: No, we do not charge for travel time within our standard service area. A mileage charge applies only for distances beyond 25 miles.

faq_knowledge.Question: How quickly can you start a job?
faq_knowledge.Answer: For urgent repairs, we can often attend same-day or next-day. For planned work, our current lead time is typically 1-2 weeks depending on the scope.

faq_knowledge.Question: Do you take card payments?
faq_knowledge.Answer: Yes, we accept all major credit and debit cards, bank transfers, and cash. Payment is due on completion unless otherwise agreed in writing.

faq_knowledge.Question: Are you insured?
faq_knowledge.Answer: Yes, we hold full public liability insurance (GBP 5 million) and employer's liability insurance. Certificates available on request.

faq_knowledge.Question: Do I need to be home during the work?
faq_knowledge.Answer: Not necessarily. Many of our clients provide keys or arrange access. We are happy to work unattended properties with prior arrangement.

faq_knowledge.Question: What happens if something goes wrong after the job?
faq_knowledge.Answer: Contact us immediately. If it's related to our work, we'll return to fix it at no charge within our guarantee period. We aim to respond within 24 hours.

faq_knowledge.Question: Can you source materials or should I buy them?
faq_knowledge.Answer: We can source all materials at trade prices, often cheaper than retail. We'll provide a breakdown in your quote. Alternatively, you're welcome to supply your own materials.

faq_knowledge.Question: Do you do commercial work or just domestic?
faq_knowledge.Answer: We handle both domestic and commercial projects. Our team has experience with offices, retail spaces, restaurants, and rental properties.

faq_knowledge.Question: How do I leave a review?
faq_knowledge.Answer: We appreciate your feedback! You can leave a review on our Google Business page. We'll send you a link after the job is completed.

legal.name: Legal & Professional Services
legal.description: For solicitors, conveyancers, paralegals, and legal practices. Manages case workflows, document deadlines, compliance requirements, and client matter tracking.

faq_knowledge.Question: What areas of law do you specialise in?
faq_knowledge.Answer: We specialise in conveyancing, family law, wills and probate, and commercial contracts. We can refer you to trusted partners for other specialisms.

faq_knowledge.Question: How much will it cost?
faq_knowledge.Answer: We offer both fixed-fee and hourly-rate arrangements depending on the matter. We'll provide a clear written estimate before commencing any work.

faq_knowledge.Question: How long will my case take?
faq_knowledge.Answer: Timeframes vary by matter type. We'll give you a realistic estimate at your initial consultation and keep you updated throughout.

faq_knowledge.Question: Will my matter be confidential?
faq_knowledge.Answer: Absolutely. All communications are protected by legal professional privilege and our strict confidentiality policies.

faq_knowledge.Question: What do I need to bring to the first meeting?
faq_knowledge.Answer: Please bring photographic ID, proof of address, and any relevant documents related to your matter. We'll confirm specifics when we schedule.

clinic.name: Medical & Dental Clinic
clinic.description: For GP practices, dental surgeries, physio clinics, and private healthcare providers. Manages patient appointments, recall reminders, compliance, and treatment plans.

faq_knowledge.Question: Do I need a referral to book an appointment?
faq_knowledge.Answer: For private appointments, no referral is needed. For NHS services, please check with your GP first.

faq_knowledge.Question: What should I bring to my first appointment?
faq_knowledge.Answer: Please bring a list of current medications, your insurance details if applicable, and any relevant medical records or test results.

faq_knowledge.Question: What is your cancellation policy?
faq_knowledge.Answer: We require 24 hours' notice for cancellations. Late cancellations may incur a fee.

faq_knowledge.Question: Do you offer emergency appointments?
faq_knowledge.Answer: Yes, we hold emergency slots each day. Please call as early as possible to secure one.

agency.name: Creative & Marketing Agency
agency.description: For marketing agencies, design studios, PR firms, and creative consultancies. Manages campaign workflows, client retainers, social media scheduling, and project delivery.

faq_knowledge.Question: What services do you offer?
faq_knowledge.Answer: We offer full-service marketing including brand strategy, social media management, content creation, PPC advertising, SEO, and website design.

faq_knowledge.Question: How much does a marketing campaign cost?
faq_knowledge.Answer: Campaign costs vary by scope and channels. We offer packages starting from GBP 1,500/month. We'll provide a tailored proposal after an initial consultation.

faq_knowledge.Question: How do you measure results?
faq_knowledge.Answer: We provide monthly reports with KPIs relevant to your goals - leads, conversions, engagement rates, ROI, and more.

faq_knowledge.Question: What is your onboarding process?
faq_knowledge.Answer: We start with a discovery session, then develop a strategy document, set up tracking and accounts, and launch within 2-3 weeks.

property.name: Property & Estate Agency
property.description: For estate agents, letting agents, property managers, and surveyors. Manages property listings, viewings, tenant communications, compliance certificates, and landlord obligations.

faq_knowledge.Question: What are your fees for selling a property?
faq_knowledge.Answer: Our commission is typically 1-1.5% + VAT of the final sale price, payable on completion. No upfront fees.

faq_knowledge.Question: How long will it take to sell my property?
faq_knowledge.Answer: The average sale time in your area is currently 8-12 weeks from listing to exchange. We'll provide a more specific estimate at valuation.

faq_knowledge.Question: Do you offer virtual viewings?
faq_knowledge.Answer: Yes, we offer virtual tours and video viewings for all our properties. We can also arrange accompanied physical viewings.

faq_knowledge.Question: What is the tenancy deposit scheme?
faq_knowledge.Answer: All deposits must be protected in a government-approved scheme within 30 days. We handle this automatically for our managed properties.

accountancy.name: Accountancy & Bookkeeping
accountancy.description: For accountants, bookkeepers, tax advisors, and payroll bureaus. Manages client deadlines, MTD compliance, document collection, and recurring billing.

faq_knowledge.Question: What accounting software do you work with?
faq_knowledge.Answer: We work with Xero, QuickBooks, Sage, and FreeAgent. We can also work with spreadsheets if you prefer.

faq_knowledge.Question: When is my tax return due?
faq_knowledge.Answer: Self-assessment tax returns are due by 31st January following the tax year end. We'll send you reminders well in advance.

faq_knowledge.Question: How much do you charge for bookkeeping?
faq_knowledge.Answer: Our bookkeeping packages start from GBP 150/month depending on transaction volume. We offer fixed monthly fees so there are no surprises.

faq_knowledge.Question: Do you handle HMRC enquiries?
faq_knowledge.Answer: Yes, we handle all HMRC correspondence and enquiries as part of our service. We'll notify you immediately if any issues arise.
